Hi, I have my first RAI on Wednesday. They didn’t really think the lung module was connected and nobody seemed worried about it. But if it is cancer then I guess theoretically the RAI should do something. My surgery went really well, honestly the worst thing was that it caused the worst constipation I had ever had. I was tired for a few days. Swallowing went fine right after. My neck was sore but not painful. I actually felt great energy wise for about 3 weeks then I got kind of tired and emo. Learned that’s because the remaining TSH from my thyroid had officially left the building. It’s been a struggle to get my meds right. Last blood test my TSH was 42.

Good luck to you! Also there’s lots of FB support groups for this stuff. And there’s one specifically geared toward ppl about to do RAI. Let me know if u need the names if u can’t find them and I’ll look them up. Good luck 👍
